verdict.rationale: GitHub Projects documents built-in workflows that automatically set fields when items are added or changed. That is a first-party trigger-and-action capability, and templates can carry configured workflows. The evidence is a single thin line, though, and does not show engineers composing arbitrary custom rules. Deeper automation is pushed to the GraphQL API and GitHub Actions, which are building blocks rather than a rule builder. Missing for 10: documented range of available triggers and actions, a custom rule-building interface, detail on configuring workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can build trigger-and-action automation rules to eliminate repetitive manual steps

citations.quote: Built-in workflows allow you to automatically set fields when items are added or changed
Project templates include the views, custom fields, draft issues and associated fields, configured workflows (except any auto-add workflows), and insights.
